1. What Lyfos is

Lyfos ("Lyfos", "we", "us") is a product by Nuviro Labs. It provides a local-first, client-encrypted personal vault and balance-sheet application accessible at lyfos.nuvirolabs.com and related domains (the "Service"). The Service is designed so that data you create stays on your device, encrypted with a key only you control.

Free beta access and paid plans may be offered depending on launch stage. Prices, taxes, renewal timing, and plan inclusions are shown before payment.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old and capable of entering into a binding contract to use the Service. By using the Service you confirm that you meet this requirement.

3. Your data, your key

The Service encrypts your vault contents on your device using a passphrase you choose and (during the Beta) stores the encrypted blob in your browser's local storage. We do not have access to your passphrase, your derived encryption key, or the plaintext contents of your vault.

If you forget your passphrase and lose your recovery key, your data cannot be recovered. We cannot help you recover it. You are responsible for keeping the passphrase and recovery key safe.

4. Release plan availability

The Service includes a feature called "Release plan" which lets you document a nominee and trusted key holders. Feature availability depends on your plan, product stage, and whether the release service has been explicitly activated for your account:

  • Local planning features may stay on your device only.
  • Paid or activated release features may require account setup, verified contact details, trusted key holders, and product-specific instructions.
  • Lyfos will only perform release workflows that are available in the product and explicitly activated under the applicable plan.

Prices, renewal terms, included features, and activation requirements are shown before payment or inside the product before you rely on them.
